description: Wärmeinfrastrukturmodell (WInfra) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Prognos AG. The purpose of the Winfra model is to (bottom-up): analyze spatial heat requirements, identify renewable potentials, simulate their integration, simulate the necessary expansion of heating networks at municipal and state level. The heating infrastructure model takes into account spatially high-resolution heating requirements (GIS) in the private household, tertiary sector, industry and public buildings sectors. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: bottom up model. Spatial resolution: federal states. Software: Python. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
